title: Showing off a new skill is listed at 30 months
summary: By about 30 months, CDC says most children call a caregiver over to watch something they can do.
body: The 30-month social list includes showing a caregiver what the child can do, using a short call that asks the adult to watch. CDC's most means 75 percent or more, so the line is not a test of one fixed sentence. The sheet is not a diagnosis. The example on the US page is the checklist's own example.

sources.title: Learn the Signs. Act Early. milestone page
sources.author: CDC
sources.note: Supports the 30-month social milestone about showing what she can do with a short call for the adult to watch. US federal page, public domain. Paraphrased, not quoted.
